name: review-tracking
title: Keeping your place in conversation review
description: Every idea from the INT-287 thread for tracking which conversation to review next, on the Conversations page as it ships: row numbers, last opened, unread dots, a reviewed checkbox, saved for later, watch history, a review mode and a review session. Then how ElevenLabs, Vapi and Intercom handle it.

{total ? `${from}–${to} of ${total}` : `No ${noun}`}
) }

export type CallStatus =
  | "cancelled"
  | "completed"
  | "dialing"
  | "expired"
  | "failed"
  | "in_progress"
  | "max_duration_reached"
  | "queued"
  | "ringing"
  /** Not one of the app's statuses today — added for the two rows asked for. */
  | "scheduled"
  | "timeout"
  | "transferred"
  | "transferring"
  | "user_rejected"
  | "voicemail"

export type ScheduleOrigin = "follow_up" | "requested"

export const SCHEDULE_ORIGIN_LABELS: Record<ScheduleOrigin, string> = {
  follow_up: "follow up",
  requested: "requested",
}

export type OutcomeStatus = "met" | "not_met" | "unavailable"

export type AgentOutcomeStatus = "helpful" | "not_helpful" | "unavailable"

export type CallDirection = "inbound" | "outbound"

export type CallRow = {
  id: string
  createdAt: string
  user: string
  interactionType: "call" | "chat"
  direction: CallDirection | null
  phoneNumber: null | string
  scenario: string
  status: CallStatus
  scheduleOrigin?: ScheduleOrigin
  outcome: OutcomeStatus
  outcomeReason: null | string
  agentOutcome: AgentOutcomeStatus
  /** m:ss, the way formatDuration prints it. */
  duration: string
}

export type ColumnId =
  | "agentOutcome"
  | "direction"
  | "duration"
  | "outcome"
  | "phoneNumber"
  | "scenario"
  | "status"
